messages:
Marta - Docs: Opening a tiny PR to correct embedding guidance and an SDK auth snippet. Not urgent but want it in before the docs freeze.
Ravi - ML Eng: which model cards?
Marta - Docs: artemis7b and zephyrx-card. The embed section currently says 'fp16 recommended' which confuses folks; we usually use int8 for embed serving.
Nora - SDK: I think the auth sample still points at /security/kms-legacy. I'll update it to /security/kms-integration.
Tanya - QA: FYI the embed throughput job showed big variance between int8 and fp16 on different GPUs. I'll surface numbers if needed.
Ravi - ML Eng: Suggested copy: 'For embeddings: prefer quantized int8 variants for cost-sensitive workloads. Use short batching windows (6-12ms). Typical observed throughput: t4 int8 ~0.3-0.5 tok/ms; A10G int8 ~0.6-0.9; A100 fp16 ~1.2-1.6. Varies by seq length.'
Priya - Product: add 10-20% cross-region latency note for small batches EU->US and a short eval checklist for similarity drift.
Marta - Docs: will draft those bits and add a one-line cost/quality tradeoff.
Nora - SDK: pushed a commit fixing the link and added a tiny python refresh snippet.
doc-bot: CI started for PR #4120 — linkcheck, snippets, lint.
Tanya - QA: linkcheck failed due to a hidden include referencing kms-legacy. Fixing now.
Marta - Docs: fixed include and updated both model cards. Pushed changes.
doc-bot: CI passed for PR #4120.
Ravi - ML Eng: approved the model numbers and wording.
Priya - Product: approved.
Marta - Docs: merged. I'll add a changelog note and ping support about the KMS link change. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
